## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the chosen solution.

## Root cause

Explain the reachable path and why existing validation did not catch it.

## Validation

List exact commands and results. Distinguish automated tests, simulation, real hardware, and real provider calls.

## Not tested

State relevant checks that were not run and why.

## Configuration and compatibility

List dependency, environment, settings, data-format, or packaging changes.

## Privacy checklist

- [ ] No API key, token, private audio, transcript, speaker profile, personal path, or unredacted log is included.
- [ ] Tests use synthetic or anonymized data.
- [ ] `npm run scan` passes.
- [ ] `npm run audit:history` passes, or the failure is an already documented pre-existing history blocker.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
